description: This Dart source file defines classes and methods for payment processing within a Flutter web frontend. It includes mock implementations for creating checkout sessions and fetching payment statuses, along with data models for sessions and statuses.

classes.name: CheckoutSession
classes.description: Represents a hosted checkout session returned by backend, containing a session ID and a checkout URL.

classes.name: PaymentStatus
classes.description: Represents the final status of a payment, including whether it succeeded, failed, or is pending, with optional receipt ID.

classes.name: PaymentsService
classes.description: Service class that manages interactions with backend payment endpoints, supporting mock mode for offline testing.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory method to asynchronously instantiate a PaymentsService with configuration from environment variables.

methods.name: createCheckoutSession
methods.description: Creates a checkout session, returning a mock session with a simulated checkout URL or throwing if real backend is not implemented.

methods.name: fetchPaymentStatus
methods.description: Fetches the payment status for a given session ID, returning a mock pending status if in mock mode.
